title: Decoding the dynamics of BCL9 triazole stapled peptide.
authors: Gaikwad, Vikram; Choudhury, Asha Rani; Chakrabarti, Rajarshi
one_liner_zh: 该文用MD和REST2模拟研究三唑钉合BCL9肽的构象动态，但对象是蛋白-蛋白互作（β-catenin/BCL9），非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无TF-DNA结合建模，仅方法上对肽构象模拟有间接参考价值。
abstract: BCL9 is a key protein in Wnt signaling pathway. It acts as a transcriptional co-activator to beta-catenin, and dysregulation in this pathway leads to tumor growth. Inhibiting such a protein-protein interaction is considered as a therapeutic challenge. The interaction between beta-catenin and BCL9 is facilitated by a 23-residue helical domain from BCL9 and a hydrophobic groove of beta-catenin. To prevent this interaction, a peptide that mimics the alpha-helical domain of BCL9 can be designed. Stapling is considered a successful strategy in the pursuit of designing such peptides in which amino acids side are stitched together using chemical moieties. Among the various types of cross-linkers, triazole is the most rapid and effective one synthesized via click reaction. However, the underlying interactions behind maintaining the secondary structure of stapled peptides remain less explored. In the current work, we employed the molecular dynamics simulation to study the conformational behavior of the experimentally synthesized single and double triazole stapled BCL9 peptide. Upon the addition of a triazole staple, there is a significant reduction in the conformational space of BCL9. The helical character of the stapled peptide increases with an increase in separation between the triazole cross-linkers. Also, we encompassed the Replica Exchange with Solute Tempering (REST2) simulation to validate the high-temperature response of the stapled peptide. From REST2, the PCA and t-SNE show the reduction in distinct cluster formation on the addition of triazole staple. Our study infers further development of these triazole-stapled BCL9 peptides into effective inhibitors to target the interaction between beta-catenin and BCL9.
abstract_zh: BCL9是Wnt信号通路中的关键蛋白。它作为β-catenin的转录共激活因子，该通路的失调会导致肿瘤生长。抑制这种蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用被视为一项治疗挑战。β-catenin与BCL9之间的相互作用由BCL9的23个残基螺旋结构域和β-catenin的疏水沟槽促进。为阻止这种相互作用，可以设计一种模拟BCL9α-螺旋结构域的肽。在追求设计此类肽的过程中，订书肽（stapling）被认为是一种成功策略，其中氨基酸侧链通过化学部分缝合在一起。在各种类型的交联剂中，三唑是通过点击反应合成的最快速且最有效的一种。然而，维持订书肽二级结构背后的相互作用仍较少被探索。在本工作中，我们采用分子动力学 (molecular dynamics) 模拟来研究实验合成的单三唑和双三唑订书BCL9肽的构象行为。添加三唑订书后，BCL9的构象空间显著减少。订书肽的螺旋特性随着三唑交联剂之间分离度的增加而增强。此外，我们采用了溶质回火副本交换 (Replica Exchange with Solute Tempering, REST2) 模拟来验证订书肽的高温响应。从REST2中，PCA和t-SNE显示，添加三唑订书后，不同簇的形成减少。我们的研究推断，这些三唑订书BCL9肽可进一步开发为有效抑制剂，以靶向β-catenin与BCL9之间的相互作用。
